title: Enterprise RAG Architecture & Ingestion Lifecycle
description: Architect end-to-end Retrieval-Augmented Generation systems in .NET, connecting ingestion pipelines, vector storage, context orchestration, and citation mechanics.

data.text: The Anatomy of an Enterprise RAG System

Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) bridges the gap between pre-trained foundational models and private, dynamic enterprise data. Without RAG, LLMs suffer from knowledge cutoff limits, lack organizational domain context, and hallucinate plausible-sounding falsehoods. A production RAG system decouples storage from inference: documents are indexed into vector and full-text databases, semantically retrieved based on user queries, and injected into prompt context windows to ground model completions.

data.caption: The Dual-Pipeline RAG Lifecycle: Asynchronous Ingestion vs Real-Time Query Retrieval
data.definition:
graph TD
    subgraph IngestionPipeline ["1. Asynchronous Ingestion Pipeline (Background Worker)"]
        RawDocs["Enterprise Docs (PDF, Word, Markdown, SQL)"] --> Extract["Document Parser & Metadata Extractor"]
        Extract --> Chunking["Semantic & Hierarchical Chunker"]
        Chunking --> EmbedGen["Embedding Model (e.g. text-embedding-3-small)"]
        EmbedGen --> VectorStore[("Vector Database: Azure AI Search / Qdrant")]
    end
    
    subgraph QueryPipeline ["2. Online Inference & Retrieval Pipeline (ASP.NET Core)"]
        UserQuery["User Question in React UI"] --> QueryRewriter["Query Expansion & HyDE Rewriter"]
        QueryRewriter --> VectorSearch["Dense Vector & BM25 Hybrid Search"]
        VectorStore -.-> VectorSearch
        VectorSearch --> Rerank["Cross-Encoder Reranker"]
        Rerank --> ContextAssembler["Context Window Builder & System Guardrails"]
        ContextAssembler --> LLM["LLM Completion (GPT-4o / Claude 3.5 Sonnet)"]
        LLM --> CitedResponse["Streaming Grounded Response with [1] Source Citations"]
    end

data.text: Core Subsystems in an Enterprise RAG Architecture

rows: Document Parser
Extract clean text, tables, layout hierarchies, and metadata
Azure Document Intelligence, Markdig, PdfPig
Losing markdown table structures or OCR text corruption
Chunking Engine
Split continuous documents into coherent semantic segments
Semantic Kernel TextChunker, Recursive Token Chunker
Splitting sentences midway; creating chunks without parent context
Embedding Generator
Translate text chunks into dense floating-point vector spaces
Microsoft.Extensions.AI IEmbeddingGenerator
Dimension mismatches; unnormalized embeddings; high API latency
Vector & Hybrid Index
Persist vectors, full-text inverted indexes, and metadata ACLs
Microsoft.Extensions.VectorData, Azure AI Search, Qdrant
Cross-tenant data leakage; stale indexes missing updated documents
Reranker & Filter
Re-score top-50 candidates using compute-heavy cross-encoders
Cohere Rerank API, Azure Semantic Ranker
Over-filtering relevant context; passing noisy distractor documents
Synthesizer / Generator
Synthesize final response grounded exclusively on retrieved facts
Microsoft.Extensions.AI IChatClient
Hallucinating facts beyond the provided context; ignoring negative constraints

data.text: The RAG Triad for Quality Assurance
To prevent regressions when tweaking chunk sizes or prompt templates, monitor the RAG Triad continuously:

items.hint: Are the retrieved chunks strictly pertinent to the query? Measured by precision@k and semantic similarity to the query.
Is every sentence in the model's answer directly supported by the retrieved context? Zero tolerance for ungrounded claims.
Does the response actually resolve the user's original query without digression?

data.title: Key Takeaways
points: Enterprise RAG separates asynchronous document ingestion from synchronous query retrieval
Always enforce tenant isolation at the vector storage query layer to prevent cross-tenant data leakage
Ground models using strict system instructions that mandate numeric bracket citations like [1] and [2]
Provide graceful fallback responses when retrieved context is insufficient instead of guessing
Continuously evaluate retrieval quality using the RAG Triad: Context Relevance, Groundedness, and Answer Relevance
data.takeaway: RAG is not just a vector lookup—it is a complete distributed software system. Decoupling ingestion, vector retrieval, and prompt synthesis creates scalable, auditable enterprise AI.
